calendar.matters:
MOTION FOR WITHDRAWAL OF ATTORNEY OF RECORD
Off Calendar Jul-16-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: Appearances
Plaintiff Ericka Frick appeared via Zoom Call.
Jonathan Joinder, Esq. and Benjamin Humphries, Esq. representing Plaintiff Ericka Frick via Zoom Video Webinar.
John Podesta, Esq. representing Defendant SF Owner and Brick and Timber, via Zoom Video Webinar.

Good cause appearing, the Court grants Plaintiff's request for an in-camera hearing.
Counsel for defedants was excused and removed from Zoom.

In Camera Hearing commences.

After considering the discussions, arguments and requests, the Court rules as follows:

PLAINTIFF ERIKA FRICK MOTION FOR WITHDRAWAL OF ATTORNEY OF RECORD is GRANTED.

The case is STAYED until August 17, 2026 to allow plaintiff time to retain new counsel.

Moving party to submit proposed order that is in compliance with CRC 3.1312(b).

Judge: Charles F. Haines; Clerk: K. Valdes; Not Reported. (D501)

MOTION FOR WITHDRAWAL OF ATTORNEY OF RECORD
Off Calendar Jun-25-2026 Continued To Jul-16-26 At 09:30 A.M. In Dept 501
MINI MINUTES: Appearances
Plaintiff Erika Frick appeared by Zoom Call.
Benjamin Humphreys, Esq. and Jonathan Joiner, Esq. representing Plaintiff via Zoom Video Webinar.
Jonathan Olston, Esq. representing Defendant Brick & Timber, et al.via Zoom Video Webinar.

Plaintiff objects to the tentative ruling.

The Court finds that Plaintiff's attorneys need to speak with Plaintiff without disclosing any privileged information that violates the attorney-client agreement.

Good cause appearing, the Court continues the motion to withdraw of attorney of record to July 16, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. in department 501. Parties waive notice.

Judge: Charles F. Haines; Clerk: K. Valdes; Not Reported. (D501)
